ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.

   A. Remove all guards
